fact: The Ministry of Health's 2024-2026 budget-programme document gives action 045006 « Systèmes d'informations et pré-archivage », run by the Direction des Systèmes d'Information, 590,406,313 FCFA for 2024, of which 300,000,000 FCFA is investment from internal resources and none from external resources, and names that directorate as the unit responsible for the indicator on private facilities integrated into the SNIGS, sourced from DHIS 2; the budget line names information systems and does not name the SNIGS or DHIS2 itself.
title: DPPD 2024 - 2026 MINISTERE DE LA SANTE (019)
publisher: Ministère de la Santé, République du Bénin
